title: Senior Sales Director - Mobility, Industrial, and Advanced Technology
job_description:
Who we are:

We are on a mission to become a leading supplier of critical materials that enable the green energy and technology revolution. Our materials and technologies are required for the electric vehicle, green energy, consumer electronics, and defense industries, and our battery grade lithium and tech metals are needed for chipsets, semiconductors, and 5G.


We have a substantial interest in the Round Top, Heavy Rare Earth, Lithium and Critical Minerals deposit in West Texas. We have also developed the United States’ first rare earth and critical minerals processing facility and we own the only scalable, sintered neo-magnet manufacturing system in the Western Hemisphere. By developing this fully integrated, US-based “mine-to-magnet” critical mineral supply chain, we are poised to become the leading domestic supplier to these industries.


What you can expect:

At USA Rare Earth, we are pioneers and problem solvers, technologists and team players. Together, we:


Build Solutions: If our task was a simple one, it would already be done. We are creative and solution-oriented, and we think outside the box to solve important problems. We know that a range of expertise and technologies is needed for success, and we work across sectors and alongside customers to deliver world-class solutions in sustainable ways.


Deliver Quality: When we do things, we do them well. We believe that top-tier quality leads to industry competitiveness and we hold ourselves to the highest quality standards. We move fast when executing, but safety, quality, and excellence always come first.


Lead responsibly: We have a responsibility to the planet, our consumers, our country, and each other. We put safety at the center of all we do, take accountability for our actions, incorporate sustainable practices in our processes and act with the financial best interest of our investors and consumers in mind.


Win Together: Establishing a rare earth magnet supply chain is a big undertaking – and getting there is a team effort. We communicate openly, work together and challenge each other in pursuit of our goals. With every step we take we learn and get better.


Job Summary:

The Sr. Sales Director - Mobility, Industrial, and Advanced Technology leads USA Rare Earth's commercial growth across the mobility, industrial, and advanced technology markets, including automotive and motor manufacturing. This senior role owns an end-to-end book of business, from strategic account planning and new program capture through demand forecasting and year-over-year account growth. The ideal candidate brings deep relationships with OEMs across these markets, understands technical, longer-cycle industrial sales, and operates independently while collaborating closely with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, and other internal leaders to win and grow programs.

Primary Target Markets:

Automotive and motor manufacturing
Industrial and commercial electric motors
Industrial automation and robotics
Humanoid robotics and autonomous systems
HVAC compressors and motion control systems
Factory automation and conveyor systems
Material handling and warehouse robotics
Other industrial equipment applications
Pumps, valves, and fluid control systems

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Sales Leadership & Account Ownership

Drive demand generation and close orders with OEM customers across the assigned region.
Rapidly build U.S. market position and brand awareness across target verticals.
Own and grow an end-to-end book of business across these focus markets, serving as the primary relationship owner for key accounts and target programs.
Develop and execute account plans aligned to annual revenue targets.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer engineering, procurement, and program management organizations.
Guide customers through material qualification and program approval processes, coordinating internal resources to support technical evaluations.
Lead development of MOUs, joint development agreements (JDAs), and supply agreements to secure 2026 and beyond volume commitments.
Represent USA Rare Earth at tradeshows, conferences, and customer events to build brand presence and generate new opportunities.

Demand Planning & Forecasting

Own end-to-end demand planning and forecasting for assigned accounts, coordinating closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing to align production capacity with customer program timelines.
Deliver monthly forecasting and demand plans, maintaining forecast accuracy of 80% or greater.
Translate customer program schedules, ramp curves, and volume forecasts into actionable production plans.
Monitor demand trends across mobility, industrial, and advanced technology markets, including electrification and automation adoption, to inform company-wide planning.

Customer & Pipeline Management (CRM)

Maintain rigorous CRM discipline ensuring account, opportunity, and pipeline data reflect current status.
Identify and qualify new opportunities, maintaining CRM pipeline coverage of at least 10 times (10x) annual revenue targets.
Develop pipeline and convert opportunities into purchase orders.
Track and report on pipeline health, win and loss trends, and account growth against annual targets.
Develop and maintain multi-year account plans and pursuit roadmaps for strategic customers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Deal Execution

Collaborate with Application Engineering and Product Marketing to align technical solutions with customer needs.
Lead contract negotiations, pricing strategy, and commercial terms for new and renewal business.
Partner with executive leadership on strategic planning, market entry, and investment prioritization for the segment.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

Monitor the competitive landscape, program timelines, and industry trends across automotive, mobility, industrial, and advanced technology markets.
Provide voice-of-customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Leadership to inform roadmap and capacity decisions.
Contribute to long-range strategic planning for the segment.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Proven track record of building and growing complex, technical accounts within long sales-cycle industrial markets.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, comfortable engaging with senior customer and internal stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage a full sales cycle, from prospecting through contract negotiation and account growth.
Skilled in industrial demand planning and forecasting, with the ability to translate customer programs into production-aligned forecasts.
Proficiency with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales preferred; Salesforce.com or Hubspot acceptable), with disciplined pipeline management process.
Strong collaborator and independent thinker, comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment.
Working knowledge of automotive, industrial motor, automation, and robotics OEM supply chains.
Familiarity with humanoid robotics, factory automation, material handling, and fluid control equipment markets.
Understanding of electrification trends, motion control architectures, and automation and robotics actuator technologies.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, Engineering or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
Experience: 10+ years of progressive commercial or sales experience, including 5+ years focused on mobility, industrial, advanced technology, or an adjacent industry.
Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and growing account revenue year over year.
Experience with industrial demand planning and forecasting in a manufacturing or industrial supply environment.
Proven CRM proficiency (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales or Salesforce.com).
Existing relationships with automotive, industrial motor, automation, robotics, or related OEM manufacturers strongly preferred.
Ability to travel 60% or more to support customer engagements, tradeshows, and other internal meetings.

Physical Demands

The work environment will primarily be a home office or typical office environment, combined with frequent customer-site and travel-related environments. Noise level: normal office noises.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
